subject: Q3 pipeline coverage check — commit confirmations & gap items
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: FP&A Team <fpandaforecast@acmeinc.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 pipeline coverage check — commit confirmations & gap items

Team —

As we close out June I want to lock the Q3 forecast. Finance asked for a final pipe-to-quota coverage check by EOD Thursday so they can bake numbers into the board pack. Goal: 3.5x coverage at the gross commit level (post-discount).

Actions I need from each AE:
- Confirm deals you are putting in Commit (closed-won expected within quarter) and provide probability, best-case close date, and any outstanding blockers.
- Move any deals that are >30% at risk back to Forecasted or Qualification; we want conservative commit counts.
- Add one-line note for each commit explaining the remaining legal/procurement steps.

Attached is my export of current pipe by stage (2026_Q3_pipe_summary.xlsx). Please update the spreadsheet (Deal ID + Stage + Commit? Y/N + $ARR commit) and re-send to me so I can reconcile with FP&A.

I’ll run a coverage gap calc and propose a set of focus plays to bridge the shortfall (if any). If you have a deal that needs frontline support (exec sponsor, legal push), copy me and Grace.

Thanks — trying to avoid a surprise at the end of July.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: 2026_Q3_pipe_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 pipeline coverage check — commit confirmations & gap items

On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 9:15 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> As we close out June I want to lock the Q3 forecast...

Karthik — thanks for the nudge. Quick updates from my side (I updated the spreadsheet and attached a short deal-level note doc):
- ACME Inc. (RDW-ACME-Q3-0892): Putting $520k ARR in Commit, probability 85%, target close 07/15. Outstanding: final legal SOW redline (discount appendix). I’ve looped in our legal ops and ACME legal but need pricing approval on a one-time onboarding credit.
- BetaHealth (RDW-BETA-Q3-0411): Moving to Forecasted — procurement timeline uncertain; $120k ARR.
- Orion Labs (RDW-ORION-Q3-0720): Commit $260k ARR, probability 70% — waiting on exec reference call this week.

Ask: Can we get pricing exception approval for the ACME onboarding credit? If not approved, I’ll mark ACME as commit contingent and drop the probability to 60%.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: deal_level_commit_notes.docx (docx)]

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 pipeline coverage check — commit confirmations & gap items

Karthik / team —

Thanks Marissa for the ACME detail. My updates (spreadsheet updated):
- FedCloud (RDW-FEDC-Q3-0999): moving $400k ARR into Commit (prob 90%) — procurement requires standard RSU clause but legal has accepted language.
- NimbusTech (RDW-NIM-Q3-0860): pushing from Commit back to Forecasted; risk flagged (50k ARR).
- ACME Inc.: + a note — they requested a 60-day SLA exception and a custom data-retention clause. These are procurement asks, not technical blockers. Legal said SLA exception is standard escalation but procurement sign-off expected.

Also: preliminary coverage calc shows we are at ~2.8x vs. the 3.5x target, assuming everyone’s current commit numbers. With the adjustments Marissa/Rohan shared we only get to ~3.0x. I’ll run the gap play list tomorrow — likely need to pull a few higher-commit deals from Forecasted into Commit (with immediate exec engagement) or identify two small cross-sell plays to cover the shortfall.

Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

> On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 11:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Karthik — thanks for the nudge...

From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acmeinc.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 pipeline coverage check — commit confirmations & gap items

Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks for the update and the transparency. A couple notes from Acme procurement/FP&A:
- We can agree to the onboarding credit as a one-time offset if Redwood can commit to the standard 12-month payment schedule; we will sign once legal finalizes the appendix.
- The SLA exception request is acceptable for evaluation but will require a written addendum. Our FP&A team asked if the onboarding credit can be separated out in the invoice (so it does not affect ARR recognition).

I’ve copied our FP&A lead so we can coordinate billing. We should be able to close by 07/15 if legal and pricing are finalized this week.

Lydia Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Inc.
